data_retention_note: Hugging Face forwards each request to the pinned third-party provider (DeepInfra), whose own data-retention policy applies. Lab camera images and depth data sent with every call leave this machine.
model_verified: 2026-10-02: router.huggingface.co/v1/models lists deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with image+text input on novita (supports_structured_output false), fireworks-ai, featherless-ai, baseten and deepinfra (status live, supports_structured_output true, 1,048,576-token context). DeepSeek has retired deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp upstream and its aliases now route to V4.1-Flash (api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news260910/, api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/). Vision is verified from the router's input modalities; reasoning tokens/text and acceptance of effort max are confirmed by the Plan 15-10 re-smoke.
notes: MLLM-01 per 15-CONTEXT.md D-13/D-15/D-20/D-21/D-23/D-27. Model switched from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp to deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash by explicit user decision on 2026-10-02 (15-LIVE-RESULTS.md section 2); this supersedes the locked D-23 model id and the D-27 choice to keep the Exp model. Evidence: DeepSeek retired V4-Flash-Vision-Exp upstream (aliases route to V4.1-Flash), and both Plan 15-10 live smoke attempts got HTTP 504 Gateway Time-out from the HF router at about 121 s (fixed separately by streaming in base_mllm_chat.py). The backend name mllm-hf-deepseek and effort max are unchanged. Pinned to deepinfra: D-23 named Novita as the host, but the router shows Novita without structured output and unpinned :fastest routing can land there (research C2, C12, Pitfall 2); deepinfra has structured output, a 1,048,576-token context and costs $0.20 input / $0.60 output per million tokens (2026-10-02). effort max is passed through as before; the levels are not enumerated, so effort_levels is null and acceptance is confirmed by the re-smoke. Cost is cents per call (research C1); no model on the router is free. No replacement from the D-23 shortlist (google/gemma-4-31B-it, zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash) was needed. The re-smoke for this variant (Plan 15-10) must confirm routing to the pinned provider, reasoning tokens and reasoning text under json_schema mode (assumptions A3/A4) and image acceptance (A6; set image_format to jpeg if the provider rejects the request size). If the pinned provider rejects json_schema, a human sets structured_mode to json_object (schema in the system prompt, client-side validation); there is no automatic fallback. api_key_env names the environment variable holding a fine-grained HF token with Inference Providers permission; never put the token itself in this file. Docs check 2026-10-02 (api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode, huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash): reasoning_effort accepts low, high, max (max valid, default high); thinking is on by default; temperature has no effect in thinking mode (sent but ignored) and top_p is clamped to at least 0.95 (0.95 sent). Whether deepinfra passes the string effort through unchanged is confirmed by the live re-smoke.
